model: Asset-Level Five-Lens Probability-Adjusted Economic Valuation Model with Current-Head Evidence Reunderwriting

currentHeadRevaluation.policy: README content is supporting evidence only. Current state is established from default-branch heads using commit chronology and diffs, first-party source, package/version metadata, tests, validation and benchmark artifacts, schemas/manifests, persistence/security/deployment surfaces and documentation. A build changes valuation only when those sources demonstrate economically relevant scope, maturity, validation, transferability, productization, risk reduction or replacement effort. Commit count and version labels are not valuation multipliers.
currentHeadRevaluation.pricingPolicy: The 8 September register remains the prior financial baseline. Current-head deltas are underwritten asset by asset. Replacement cost changes only for additional evidenced work product; maturity changes require stronger execution evidence; the other analytical lenses are recalculated consistently with the existing model factors. The seller ask remains a separate acquisition position and is adjusted only where current-head evidence materially changes the asset's commercial or transfer profile.

confidence.replacementCost: medium; current-head deltas reviewed, but the full non-code component audit remains incomplete
confidence.marketComparableProxy: low-to-medium-by-sector; primary transaction anchors available but direct asset comparability not established
confidence.incomeLicensingProxy: low; buyer-specific cash-flow and royalty evidence not established
confidence.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: modelled with explicit probabilities and current-head maturity treatment

externalEvidence.policy: External transaction evidence calibrates sector demand and confidence before it changes asset value. Mature-company transaction values or revenue multiples are not copied directly into pre-revenue or early-stage asset valuations.

replacementCostScope.status: current-head build deltas have been reviewed, while the portfolio is still not represented as a fully componentized all-in replacement-cost audit
replacementCostScope.policy: Do not automatically uplift the baseline. Audit architecture, research, QA/validation, security, deployment, documentation, data/model assets, productization, compliance, IP/licence qualification and programme management asset by asset while avoiding double counting.

definitions.replacementCost: Current seller-side estimate for recreating comparable present work product. The 12 September revaluation adds only current-head development deltas supported by repository evidence; the broader all-in component audit is still incomplete.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Modelled marketability indication using maturity, commercial-potential and sector factors. Primary-source transaction anchors calibrate evidence confidence, but the figure is not a verified comparable-transactions valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Modelled monetization indication using maturity, commercial-potential and route-to-market factors. It is not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation because asset-specific revenue forecasts and royalty benchmarks are not established.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Replacement-cost anchored opportunity value adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, a rights/transfer diligence reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Weighted preliminary seller-side economic reference combining the four valuation lenses above. It is not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Current seller-side acquisition asking reference. It is independent from the analytical value model and is re-underwritten only when asset-specific current-head evidence materially changes the commercial or transfer profile.
definitions.externalEvidenceConfidence: A confidence measure for the existence and relevance of primary-source sector transaction evidence. It is not a valuation multiplier and does not establish direct comparability.

nextGates: Run full asset-by-asset replacement-cost component audits beyond the current-head development deltas, without double counting.
Match subject assets to narrower precedent transactions or licences by rights, maturity, sector, geography, useful life and date.
Introduce defensible royalty benchmarks and buyer-specific income forecasts where commercialization routes are credible.
Replace remaining generic technical and commercialization probabilities with asset-specific retained evidence.
Re-weight valuation lenses by asset according to evidence quality rather than applying one universal portfolio weighting.
